# Algorithmic_Warfare

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of AI-driven algorithms to autonomously or semi-autonomously select, target, and engage military objectives, shifting from human-directed to data-driven combat decisions. For iNEST, this concept drives the need for ultra-low-latency, in-network neuromorphic processing to enable real-time tactical decision-making at the edge.
